title: Choose a visualization for a question

blocks.content: Practice choosing a visualization from the viewer's question. Start with the question: a current value, proximity to a limit, comparison across categories, share of a total, or exact row values. Follow each question to a stat, gauge or bar gauge, bar chart, pie chart, or table.
Use the demo dashboards on Grafana Play. You don't need to create resources. Any editor changes are temporary. Leave without saving.
